models.use: Drafts example sentences and Hebrew wordings of questions. Default generator on a CPU box.
First judge in the two-judge check (never the generator of the item it judges).
Second judge on a CPU box; fallback generator; base weights for the offensive-language screen.

Screens every generated Hebrew string. A LoRA adapter on dicta-il/dictalm2.0-instruct; it labels text and writes nothing that ships. Its card says the rationales it was trained on came from a commercial teacher model, which is one more reason it only screens.

models.use: Finds the exact span of a cited verse that an Ask the Torah answer quotes.
Build-time vectors for the search index (verse retrieval for Ask the Torah, related-entry vectors, cross-language terms). The optional on-device query pack is not built yet.
Fill-in-the-word items for Torah and prayer lines: checks the missing word is recoverable from the line and proposes wrong choices.
Lane 4's model. Lane 5 runs it locally for the gender and number agreement check until Lane 4 publishes its per-sentence output; judge.py takes that output with --morph-json when it exists.
Lane 1's model. Lane 5 runs it locally for the translation round-trip check until Lane 1's translation memory exists.
Preferred generator when a GPU box is approved. Not run for v0.1.0 (no GPU, no spend).
